description: Main application source code for a Bluetooth peripheral device using Zephyr RTOS, implementing environmental sensing and battery services with simulated sensor data.

methods.name: read_u16
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit unsigned value from GATT attribute, converting to little-endian.

methods.name: read_es_measurement
methods.description: Reads environmental sensing measurement data over GATT.

methods.name: read_temp_trigger_setting
methods.description: Reads temperature trigger setting based on condition.

methods.name: check_condition
methods.description: Checks if sensor condition for notification is met.

methods.name: update_temperature
methods.description: Updates temperature sensor value and sends notification if condition is met.

methods.name: ess_simulate
methods.description: Simulates sensor data updates for temperature and humidity.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main application entry point, initializes Bluetooth, handles simulation loop.
